root_cause: The canonical automated recovery existed but an operator could neither invoke the protected Netlify scheduled endpoint nor inspect the exact closed-loop blocker when no daily provider publication appeared. Invoking only the publisher would also be insufficient when the missing prerequisite is content generation, media readiness, provider preflight or orchestration.
prevention_rule: Provide an auditable same-day recovery control plane that can be started by workflow_dispatch or a reviewed main-branch request marker, retrieves the existing scheduler token only inside GitHub Actions, invokes the full canonical powerhouse-content-loop, persists sanitized loop and decision evidence, and never introduces a second provider writer or bypasses identity, capability, uniqueness or provider-readback gates.
